user.title: Aiwit / EKEN
user.description: Enter your Aiwit/EKEN cloud account credentials and the two client keys. The keys are not shipped with this integration: extract them from the official app package with tools/extract_keys.py (see README). Use a dedicated secondary account if possible.

data.udid: Client UDID (optional, leave empty to auto-generate)

reauth_confirm.title: Aiwit / EKEN — client keys required
reauth_confirm.description: This entry was created before the client keys were required. Run tools/extract_keys.py on the official app package (see README) and enter the two keys.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Aiwit cloud (check credentials and client keys)

init.title: Aiwit / EKEN — options
init.description: Update credentials, client keys and/or the thumbnail output directory. Leave the password empty to keep the current one. Leave the thumbnail path empty to use the default (<config>/www/aiwit → /local/aiwit/...). Use an absolute path already in your allowlist (e.g. /media/your_storage/aiwit/thumbnails) for notifications.

data.password: New password (leave empty to keep current)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Aiwit cloud (check credentials and client keys)
